0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The debonair dame has lost something of great import.

25.original: Return the jewelry to the debonair dame.

48.original: Pardon the imposition, but I am in desperate need of your assistance. I lost several pieces of jewelry that are ever so dear to my heart in the commotion, and I've been quite unable to locate them.

49.original: I am searching for a tiara emblazoned with my house's crest, an engraved necklace, and an amethyst ring. As you might guess, each is a family heirloom.

50.original: I know not where I dropped them, out of my wits as I was at the time, but they cannot have vanished into thin air. They must be in the city somewhere, if only I had the faintest inkling of where to look...

51.original: Please, might I beg your help? I would give anything to have them safely returned to me.

52.original: I apologize that I have no clearer idea of where I might have dropped them, but please, I need my heirlooms returned to me!

53.original: Were you able to locate any of my heirlooms?

54.original: Oh, my, you've found all three! There can be no mistake!

55.original: “Seek but to serve” is inscribed here, you see? It was my family's motto long before we came to Eulmore. My grandmother taught me its meaning─that we ought always love others before ourselves, aid the poor and the downtrodden...

56.original: And I see with clarity, now. It is <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> spirit that those of us in Eulmore have been lacking, and which we must reclaim. Like my ancestors─like you─we must learn to care for others regardless of the benefit to ourselves.

57.original: I know not how I can possibly thank you enough for this, but please believe that you have my eternal gratitude.
